items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had Billy Wallace with me... I had him playing the piano.

ctx.x: That was a big – the cats thought that was a big loss too, though.

Oh yeah. Clifford came by and played. I had Billy Wallace with me, and he loved Clifford, just idolized him. I had him playing the piano. He invited Clifford by. Clifford came by and just knocked everybody out. He shot pool a lot too. He was a great pool player. They had a pool room back past the liquor store there.
Because he didn’t drink or nothing, right? He was real clean.
